project_conventions: pnpm monorepo (workspaces apps/* and packages/*). Production code lives in apps/<name>/src and packages/<name>/src; tests are *.spec.ts next to the code they cover (apps/web also uses apps/web/test/). Root Node scripts live in scripts/*.mjs with *.spec.mjs specs. Database migrations live in packages/db/migrations. The Rust engine lives in engine/ptcg-core and engine/ptcg-cli (Cargo workspace at engine/Cargo.toml, created by S04.T01) and is tested through `pnpm engine:test`, never by touching the database.
